svg.title: Lantern Vale — fishing and mining buildings
svg.desc: Implemented Canvas artwork for the five fishing and mining building families, with unchanged game trees and workers. Main views use level two. Thumbnails show every structural tier.
svg.text: Actual renderer artwork • broad surfaces • readable props • all structural tiers below each scene
Warm windows and profession cues remain.
Capacity and equipment upgrades remain visible.
Existing footprints and workers stay authoritative.
Main scenes enlarged 2.05×; tier thumbnails 0.7×. Labels and poses are for comparison; worker count is illustrative.
